name: manychat-translator
description: Chrome extension (MV3) that detects Manychat chat messages and duplicates them inline. Future-ready scaffold for an AI translation layer.

scripts.dev: vite build --watch -c vite.content.config.ts & vite build --watch -c vite.background.config.ts & vite build --watch -c vite.popup.config.ts
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && vite build -c vite.background.config.ts && vite build -c vite.popup.config.ts
